newsitem.title: USA: Etec Systems sees lower Q1 revs, net.
newsitem.headline: Etec Systems sees lower Q1 revs, net.

text.p: Etec Systems Inc said it expects first quarter revenues and earnings will be significantly lower than analysts' current expectations.
Etec said that one or more systems originally scheduled to ship during the first quarter of fiscal 1997, ending November 1, will be delayed until the second quarter of fiscal 1997.
We are committed to working with our customers and satisfying their requirements."
Delayed systems should ship in the second quarter of fiscal 1997, it said.
According to First Call, the mean earnings estimates for the first quarter is for Etec to report $0.38 vs $0.14 a shares ago.

The company previously experienced a customer acceptance delay in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1995. The customer requested additional testing of the system, which resulted in a shipment delay into the following quarter.
